newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Rolo says 96 div in line with hopes.
newsitem.headline: Italy Rolo says 96 div in line with hopes.

text.p: Italy's Credito Romagnolo will pay a dividend in line with shareholders' expectations, the bank's president Aristide Canosani told a shareholders' assembly.
Rolo more than doubled its net profit to 408 billion lire from 167 billion in 1995 and a gross operating profit of 960 billion lire, a rise of 11 percent over the previous year.
The dividend will be announced on February 25. The bank paid a 200 lire dividend for 1995.
Shareholders approved a three-for-ten bonus issue raising capital to 435 billion from 334 billion lire.
Rolo is owned by Credito Italiano.
